description: Minimum evidence shape required to reproduce each open canonical issue at plan time. Paraphrased from the assurance projection: no private log text, run identifiers, digests, or absolute paths. Artifact and record names are relative run-directory names and event kinds.

fixtures.defect_class: degraded optional tooling left unrecorded
fixtures.observed: Every turn opens with a repeated transport failure against an optional tool endpoint and no record captures the degradation.
fixtures.expected: A bounded structured diagnostic records the optional-tool degradation without failing an otherwise authorized run.

fixtures.defect_class: terminal artifacts missing or out of order
fixtures.observed: A finished turn has no readable result document while the event stream already claims the turn completed.
fixtures.expected: Every finished turn has a readable, ordered terminal artifact set persisted before completion is announced.

fixtures.defect_class: review continuation contradicts its own blocker
fixtures.observed: A non-bypassable repository-footprint failure paused the run while review continuation reported eligible true with a null blocker.
fixtures.expected: One authoritative evaluation makes eligible true impossible while a repository blocker exists.

fixtures.defect_class: evidence no deterministic check classifies
fixtures.observed: A finished-turn record reports a failure that no deterministic check accounts for.
fixtures.expected: Every declared evidence family is accounted for by a deterministic check or an explicit recorded omission.

fixtures.defect_class: expansion documents collected as malformed session scopes
fixtures.observed: Expansion documents are collected as session scopes and reported unavailable with reason malformed.
fixtures.expected: Scope collection covers only real session documents and excludes expansion documents.

fixtures.defect_class: repair materialization blocked by a stale progress journal
fixtures.observed: A repair session materialized successfully and the run then paused solely because the progress journal was stale.
fixtures.expected: A stale progress journal is mechanically repaired when plan state proves the repair safe.

fixtures.defect_class: semantic audit unjudged after workspace mutation
fixtures.observed: The semantic audit could not be judged because the auditor mutated the workspace.
fixtures.expected: Mutation detection stays fail-closed and retries only in a fresh restricted attempt, never restoring or hiding the mutation.

fixtures.defect_class: rejected turn marked non-anomalous
fixtures.observed: A turn recording a malformed-plan status with a plan error, no after snapshot, and no completed session is marked anomalous false.
fixtures.expected: Anomaly classification derives from the accepted turn snapshot so a rejected turn cannot be recorded as normal.

fixtures.defect_class: completion event digests disagree with the stored result
fixtures.observed: Persisted completion records carry pre-ledger after digests that disagree with their stored turn results.
fixtures.expected: Completion is emitted only after the result and state are durable, and its digests match the persisted result.

fixtures.defect_class: undeclared write outside the registered workspace
fixtures.observed: A session declaring no writable repository aliases reported changing a home-directory file and installing a binary, and the write guard still passed.
fixtures.expected: Writes declared outside a registered authorized alias are rejected and reported as external-write detection.

fixtures.defect_class: success claimed over skipped required checks
fixtures.observed: A run reports success while required verification checks recorded themselves as skipped.
fixtures.expected: Only unexpected or required skipped checks count as success contradictions; expected conditional diagnostics stay neutral.

fixtures.defect_class: stale action state survives a consumed reply
fixtures.observed: After a reply cleared the mailbox wait and the next turn completed, the unpaused status still projects the earlier action record as current.
fixtures.expected: Action state derives from the current unresolved pause only and clears when its reply is consumed.

fixtures.defect_class: owner-dependent pause projected as unrecoverable and unattended
fixtures.observed: A pause whose worker and pause event both say the operator must choose projects recoverable false and requires_user false.
fixtures.expected: One central mapping derives recoverable and requires_user from the pause reason.

fixtures.defect_class: session reopened without a recorded transition
fixtures.observed: The event stream records a session reaching complete with zero pending while the final plan and status projections restore it to pending with no event recording the reversal.
fixtures.expected: Every reopen of a previously complete session emits its own event so replay matches the final projection.

fixtures.defect_class: semantic audit unjudged after malformed output
fixtures.observed: The semantic audit could not be judged because the auditor returned malformed output.
fixtures.expected: Malformed auditor output triggers a bounded correction carrying the exact schema and validator detail.

fixtures.defect_class: semantic audit unjudged after incomplete lane coverage
fixtures.observed: The semantic audit could not be judged because lane coverage was incomplete, without naming what prevented it.
fixtures.expected: Missing lane records are distinguished from legitimately unavailable lanes and the blocking check or evidence omission is reported.

fixtures.defect_class: unrecoverable pause on a mechanically malformed handoff
fixtures.observed: A harness exited zero and reported the session complete, but an unqualified files-modified entry made the post-turn snapshot null and paused the run with no correction attempt.
fixtures.expected: A mechanically malformed or incomplete handoff receives one bounded correction attempt before an unrecoverable pause.

fixtures.defect_class: reply origin erased by redaction
fixtures.observed: A reply keeps its run, session, turn, relative path and length while its origin is emitted as an unparsable placeholder.
fixtures.expected: Reply origin is preserved as an allowlisted enum value such as argv, stdin, or mailbox.

fixtures.defect_class: linked worktree mutation unobserved
fixtures.observed: A handoff states the turn detached and restored a linked worktree of a registered repository while no guard evidence recorded the mutation.
fixtures.expected: Linked worktrees are discovered from porcelain worktree metadata and their ref and status movement is snapshotted before and after the turn.

fixtures.defect_class: valid review verdict discarded with its handoff
fixtures.observed: A review turn exited zero and wrote both canonical review artifacts, yet no verdict was recorded because the surrounding handoff metadata was incomplete.
fixtures.expected: A valid canonical review artifact is parsed and preserved even when auxiliary handoff metadata is missing.

fixtures.defect_class: progress journal absent from the evidence index
fixtures.observed: A turn records the progress journal as appended and both packets instruct the agent to read it, yet it is absent from the audit evidence index.
fixtures.expected: The progress journal is indexed as evidence or an explicit omission is recorded.

fixtures.defect_class: whole-tree gate never rerun after later mutations
fixtures.observed: The only whole-tree gate executed once, before eight later repair sessions mutated the tree, and no baseline gate ran after the final repair.
fixtures.expected: Baseline verification runs after the final repair mutation and before any all-clear.

fixtures.defect_class: CPU progress asserted without a usable delta
fixtures.observed: A heartbeat carrying a null CPU delta and zero confirming samples still reports progressing false.
fixtures.expected: CPU progress is null when no usable delta exists.

fixtures.defect_class: final projection frozen before repair materialization
fixtures.observed: The durable plan contains a pending repair session named by the pause event while the persisted final projection remains the pre-materialization snapshot.
fixtures.expected: A fresh plan snapshot is reparsed after any repair materialization so the projection matches the durable plan.

fixtures.defect_class: runner status inferred from a transcript stream
fixtures.observed: A turn was recorded complete with its status read from the harness error stream rather than from the agent's final message.
fixtures.expected: Status markers are read only from the final message or a dedicated structured control channel, and missing status is unreported.

fixtures.defect_class: observed harness model never projected
fixtures.observed: Persisted state and every implementation turn report a default model label with source unresolved while the harness logs identify the executing model.
fixtures.expected: Requested and observed models are recorded separately and the harness-reported observed model is preferred over an unresolved default label.

fixtures.defect_class: run authorized by a reused reduced readiness report
fixtures.observed: A run was authorized by a reused, reduced readiness report whose turn-budget finding no longer described the changed plan.
fixtures.expected: Core readiness reruns before any newly materialized session launches, and the reuse, repair, or rerun reason is persisted.

fixtures.defect_class: exhausted repair group reported as all-complete
fixtures.observed: A run terminated with an exhausted repair group and two unresolved high-severity findings while status reported ok true with reason all-complete.
fixtures.expected: All-complete is reserved for a fresh zero-pending plan with successful required verification and no unresolved terminal blocker.

fixtures.defect_class: repair gated only by checks the reviewer authored
fixtures.observed: Repair sessions were gated only by verification checks authored by the same review harness that filed the findings.
fixtures.expected: Reviewer-authored checks add diagnostics or focused proof but never replace the plan-owned baseline gates.

fixtures.defect_class: finding churn hides review non-convergence
fixtures.observed: Every review cycle reports an empty repeated-findings set because each cycle replaced all textual fingerprints.
fixtures.expected: Unresolved findings are tracked by canonical assurance identity and finding churn counts as non-progress.

fixtures.defect_class: substring redaction erases an alias list
fixtures.observed: The authorized alias list is redacted while the sibling read and write alias lists are recorded in full.
fixtures.expected: Redaction matches secret key path segments rather than substrings, so an alias list is not redacted.

fixtures.defect_class: review turn rendered an implementation packet
fixtures.observed: Turns recorded as review sessions on the review harness received packets instructing the agent to implement the session.
fixtures.expected: Implementation and review packets are separate templates and reviewers receive read-only verdict instructions.

fixtures.defect_class: idle accounting absorbs active verification
fixtures.observed: Reported idle seconds between turns are almost exactly the duration of the preceding turn's verification checks.
fixtures.expected: Idle time is measured from the end of the preceding turn's active verification and finalization.

fixtures.defect_class: failed gate reported without usable diagnostics
fixtures.observed: A review-output gate exited nonzero with zero-byte output streams while the pause reported only a command failure and a truncated validator description.
fixtures.expected: Validator predicate failures return structured diagnostics instead of empty output.

fixtures.defect_class: completion announced before its guards ran
fixtures.observed: Completion was emitted and acknowledged for a session before the mailbox completion guard failed and reverted that session.
fixtures.expected: The mailbox completion guard runs before completion so the completion event is emitted only for an accepted turn.

fixtures.defect_class: unanswered blocking question projected as unattended
fixtures.observed: A run paused on an unanswered blocking mailbox question while terminal status reported a null action record and requires_user false.
fixtures.expected: An actionable blocking question projects requires_user true with a matching action record.

fixtures.defect_class: turn mutated another session's plan artifact
fixtures.observed: A packet fixed one selected session while the harness log records modifying another session's expansion document, and the turn was still accepted.
fixtures.expected: Plan artifacts are hashed before the turn and mutation of another session or expansion document is rejected.

fixtures.defect_class: duplicate canonical issue for one model-projection defect
fixtures.observed: A second canonical issue describes the same unresolved model-projection defect already tracked by an earlier canonical issue.
fixtures.expected: Reconciliation binds the duplicate to the earlier canonical issue through an explicitly reviewed manifest, never automatically.
